Welcome to our dedicated film lab in Edinburgh, offering high-quality film developing and scanning services. Our lab is passionate about preserving the art of analog photography.

Our Services

We provide both developing and scanning services for your analog film. Whether you've captured memories or artistic shots, we can bring them back to life.

Prices

brief: Invoice tool for freelance illustrators who bill in multiple currencies
family: Art direction: Global Printshop. An homage to global postal systems and analog printmaking (risograph, offset). It leans into the idea of physical currency and the tactile nature of illustration, crossing digital borders.
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Global Printshop | Invoices Without Borders</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo+Black&family=Work+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            /* Palette */
            --pink: #FF3366;
            --marigold: #FFD700;
            --cyan: #00FFFF;
            --paper: #F4F0EA;
            --blue: #0A1128;
            
            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Archivo Black', sans-serif;
            --font-text: 'Work Sans', sans-serif;
            
            /* Spacing */
            --sp-1: 0.5rem;
            --sp-2: 1rem;
            --sp-3: 1.5rem;
            --sp-4: 2rem;
            --sp-6: 3rem;
            --sp-8: 4rem;
            --sp-12: 6rem;
            --sp-16: 8rem;

            /* Borders */
            --border-thick: 3px solid var(--blue);
            --border-thin: 1px solid var(--blue);
            --border-dashed: 2px dashed var(--blue);
        }

        /* Reset & Base */
        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        body {
            background-color: var(--paper);
            color: var(--blue);
            font-family: var(--font-text);
            font-size: 16px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* SVG Noise Texture Overlay */
        body::after {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 9999;
            opacity: 0.4;
            background: url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%3Csvg viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"%3E%3Cfilter id="noiseFilter"%3E%3CfeTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.85" numOctaves="3" stitchTiles="stitch"/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width="100%25" height="100%25" filter="url(%23noiseFilter)"/%3E%3C/svg%3E');
            mix-blend-mode: multiply;
        }

        /* Typography System */
        h1, h2, h3, h4, .display-type {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            line-height: 1.1;
        }
        
        .h1 { font-size: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem); }
        .h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem); }
        .h3 { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); }
        .text-lg { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; }
        
        /* Signature Riso Hover Effect */
        .riso-block {
            position: relative;
            background: transparent;
            border: var(--border-thick);
            display: inline-block;
            cursor: pointer;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        .riso-block::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: var(--color, var(--cyan));
            z-index: -1;
            transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }
        .riso-block:hover::before {
            transform: translate(6px, 6px);
        }

        /* Navigation */
        nav {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4);
            border-bottom: var(--border-thick);
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            background: var(--paper);
            z-index: 100;
        }
        .logo { font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }
        .nav-links { display: flex; gap: var(--sp-4); align-items: center; }
        .nav-item { 
            text-decoration: none; 
            color: var(--blue); 
            font-weight: 600; 
            text-transform: uppercase; 
            font-size: 1rem; /* Increased font-size */
            letter-spacing: 0.08em; /* Added slight letter-spacing */
            transition: color 0.15s ease;
        }
        .nav-item:hover { color: var(--pink); }
        
        .btn-primary {
            padding: var(--sp-2) var(--sp-4);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: 0.875rem;
            color: var(--blue);
            text-decoration: none;
            --color: var(--marigold);
        }

        /* Hero Primary Button */
        .btn-hero {
            padding: 1.25rem 2.5rem; /* Increased padding */
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: 1.25rem; /* Increased font-size */
            color: var(--blue);
            text-decoration: none;
            background-color: var(--marigold);
            border: var(--border-thick);
            box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px var(--blue); /* Solid black drop shadow */
            display: inline-flex;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            transition: all 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }
        .btn-hero:hover {
            transform: translate(-2px, -2px);
            box-shadow: 7px 7px 0px var(--blue);
            background-color: var(--cyan);
        }
        .btn-hero:active {
            transform: translate(3px, 3px);
            box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px var(--blue);
        }

        /* Section 1: Hero (Split Screen) */
        .hero {
            display: flex;
            min-height: calc(100vh - 70px);
            border-bottom: var(--border-thick);
        }
        .hero-left {
            width: 50%;
            padding: var(--sp-8) var(--sp-4);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            border-right: var(--border-thick);
        }
        .stamped-text {
            transform: rotate(-2deg);
            margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
            line-height: 1.15; /* Increased slightly for better legibility */
        }
        .hero-left p {
            max-width: 400px;
            margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
        }
        .hero-right {
            width: 50%;
            background-color: var(--pink);
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        
        /* 3D Receipt Animation */
        .receipt-stack {
            position: relative;
            width: 300px;
            height: 400px;
            perspective: 1000px;
            transform-style: preserve-3d;
        }
        .receipt {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            width: 100%; height: 100%;
            background: var(--paper);
            border: var(--border-thick);
            padding: var(--sp-4);
            box-shadow: 10px 10px 0px rgba(10, 17, 40, 0.1);
            transform-origin: center center;
            animation: floatReceipt 8s infinite ease-in-out alternate;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--sp-2);
        }
        .receipt::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: var(--sp-4); right: var(--sp-4);
            width: 50px; height: 50px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 3px solid var(--blue);
            opacity: 0.5;
        }
        .r-line { height: 12px; background: var(--blue); opacity: 0.2; }
        .r-line.short { width: 50%; }

        /* Abstract Squiggles */
        .squiggle-path {
            fill: none;
            stroke: var(--blue);
            stroke-width: 4;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
        }

        .receipt:nth-child(1) { background: var(--cyan); transform: translateZ(40px) rotateZ(-5deg) rotateX(10deg); animation-delay: 0s; z-index: 3;}
        .receipt:nth-child(2) { background: var(--marigold); transform: translateZ(20px) rotateZ(3deg) rotateX(5deg) translateX(20px); animation-delay: -2s; z-index: 2;}
        .receipt:nth-child(3) { background: var(--paper); transform: translateZ(0px) rotateZ(-2deg) translateY(20px); animation-delay: -4s; z-index: 1;}
        
        @keyframes floatReceipt {
            0% { transform: translateZ(40px) rotateZ(-5deg) rotateX(10deg) translateY(0); }
            100% { transform: translateZ(60px) rotateZ(-2deg) rotateX(15deg) translateY(-15px); }
        }

        /* Section 2: How it Works (Mechanical Timeline) */
        .timeline-section {
            padding: var(--sp-12) var(--sp-4);
            border-bottom: var(--border-thick);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .timeline-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: var(--sp-12); }
        .timeline-track {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            position: relative;
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        /* The dashed line */
        .timeline-track::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 60px; left: 0; right: 0;
            border-top: var(--border-dashed);
            z-index: 0;
        }
        .step {
            position: relative;
            width: 30%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        .step-icon {
            width: 120px; height: 120px;
            background: var(--paper);
            border: var(--border-thick);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: 3rem;
            margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
            position: relative;
            background: var(--color, var(--cyan));
        }
        /* Fake mechanical bits */
        .step-icon::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -20px; left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 20px; height: 20px;
            background: var(--blue);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }
        .step h3 { margin-bottom: var(--sp-2); font-size: 1.5rem; }
        .step p { font-size: 0.9rem; }

        /* Section 3: Venn Diagram */
        .venn-section {
            padding: var(--sp-12) 0;
            border-bottom: var(--border-thick);
            background: var(--paper);
            text-align: center;
        }
        .venn-header { padding: 0 var(--sp-4); margin-bottom: var(--sp-8); }
        .venn-container {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 700px;
            height: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            isolation: isolate;
        }
        .venn-circle {
            position: absolute;
            width: 380px; height: 380px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            mix-blend-mode: multiply;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: var(--sp-4);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }
        .vc-cyan { background: var(--cyan); top: 20px; left: 50px; }
        .vc-pink { background: var(--pink); top: 20px; right: 50px; }
        .vc-yellow { background: var(--marigold); bottom: 20px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
        
        .venn-label {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: var(--blue);
            position: absolute;
            text-align: center;
            z-index: 10;
        }
        .vl-cyan { top: 120px; left: 100px; }
        .vl-pink { top: 120px; right: 100px; }
        .vl-yellow { bottom: 80px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
        
        .vl-center {
            top: 50%; left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            font-size: 0.95rem; /* Reduced font-size to prevent cramping */
            line-height: 1.2;
            background: var(--paper);
            padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4); /* Increased padding */
            border: var(--border-thick);
            white-space: nowrap;
            box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px var(--blue); /* Added shadow for brutalist styling */
        }

        /* Section 4: Studio Tour (Masonry Grid) */
        .studio-section {
            border-bottom: var(--border-thick);
            background: var(--blue);
            color: var(--paper);
        }
        .studio-header {
            padding: var(--sp-8) var(--sp-4);
            border-bottom: var(--border-thick);
            border-color: var(--paper);
        }
        .studio-header h2 { color: var(--paper); }
        .grid-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
            grid-auto-rows: 100px;
            gap: 20px;
            padding: var(--sp-8) var(--sp-4);
            background: var(--blue);
        }
        .photo-card {
            position: relative;
            border: 4px solid var(--paper);
            background: var(--paper);
        }
        .photo-card img {
            width: 100%; height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            filter: grayscale(20%) contrast(120%);
        }
        .tape-label {
            position: absolute;
            background: var(--paper);
            color: var(--blue);
            padding: var(--sp-1) var(--sp-2);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            border: 2px solid var(--blue);
            box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px var(--cyan);
            z-index: 2;
        }
        /* Positioning logic */
        .pc-1 { grid-column: 1 / 6; grid-row: 1 / 5; transform: rotate(-2deg); z-index: 2; }
        .pc-1 .tape-label { top: -10px; right: -10px; transform: rotate(4deg); }
        
        .pc-2 { grid-column: 5 / 10; grid-row: 3 / 8; transform: rotate(1deg); z-index: 1; }
        .pc-2 .tape-label { bottom: 20px; left: -15px; transform: rotate(-3deg); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px var(--pink);}
        
        .pc-3 { grid-column: 9 / 13; grid-row: 1 / 6; transform: rotate(3deg); z-index: 3; }
        .pc-3 .tape-label { top: 20px; right: -10px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px var(--marigold);}
        
        .pc-4 { grid-column: 2 / 7; grid-row: 6 / 10; transform: rotate(-1deg); z-index: 4; }
        .pc-4 .tape-label { bottom: -10px; right: 20px; }

        /* Section 5: Pricing (Manifest Form) */
        .pricing-section {
            padding: var(--sp-12) var(--sp-4);
            border-bottom: var(--border-thick);
            background: var(--paper);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .manifest-form {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 800px;
            border: 4px solid var(--blue);
            background: #fff;
            padding: var(--sp-4);
            position: relative;
        }
        .manifest-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            border-bottom: var(--border-thick);
            padding-bottom: var(--sp-2);
            margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
        }
        .m-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 2rem; }
        .barcode {
            width: 150px; height: 40px;
            background: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--blue), var(--blue) 2px, transparent 2px, transparent 6px, var(--blue) 6px, var(--blue) 10px, transparent 10px, transparent 12px, var(--blue) 12px, var(--blue) 16px);
        }
        .manifest-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: baseline;
            margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
            font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .m-label { flex-shrink: 0; margin-right: var(--sp-2); }
        .m-dots {
            flex-grow: 1;
            border-bottom: 2px dotted var(--blue);
            margin: 0 var(--sp-2);
            position: relative;
            top: -6px;
        }
        .m-value { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 1.2rem; }
        .stamp-graphic {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%; right: -20px;
            width: 120px; height: 120px;
            border: 4px solid var(--pink);
            border-radius: 50%;
            color: var(--pink);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            line-height: 1;
            transform: rotate(-15deg);
            opacity: 0.8;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .stamp-inner { border: 1px solid var(--pink); border-radius: 50%; padding: 10px; width: 100px; height: 100px; display: flex; align-items: center;}

        /* Section 6: CTA */
        .cta-section {
            background: var(--pink);
            padding: 0;
            border-bottom: var(--border-thick);
            position: relative;
        }
        .cta-btn {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            padding: var(--sp-12) var(--sp-4);
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--blue);
            text-align: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            text-decoration: none;
        }
        .cta-btn .h1 { transition: transform 0.1s ease; display: inline-block; }
        /* Physical click mechanism */
        .cta-btn::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: var(--cyan);
            z-index: -1;
            transform: scaleY(0);
            transform-origin: bottom;
            transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }
        .cta-section:hover .cta-btn::before { transform: scaleY(1); }
        .cta-section:hover .cta-btn .h1 { transform: translateY(5px); }

        /* Footer */
        footer {
            padding: var(--sp-6) var(--sp-4);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
            font-size: 0.875rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .hero { flex-direction: column; height: auto; }
            .hero-left, .hero-right { width: 100%; border-right: none; border-bottom: var(--border-thick); }
            .hero-right { padding: var(--sp-12) 0; }
            
            .timeline-track { flex-direction: column; gap: var(--sp-8); }
            .timeline-track::before {
                top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 60px; right: auto;
                border-top: none; border-left: var(--border-dashed);
            }
            .step { width: 100%; flex-direction: row; text-align: left; gap: var(--sp-4); }
            .step-icon { margin-bottom: 0; flex-shrink: 0; }
            .step-icon::after { bottom: 50%; left: -20px; top: auto; transform: translateY(50%); }

            .venn-container { height: 400px; transform: scale(0.8); }
            
            .grid-container { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
            .photo-card { transform: none !important; margin-bottom: var(--sp-4); }
        }
        
        @media (max-width: 500px) {
            .venn-container { transform: scale(0.6); margin-top: -50px; margin-bottom: -50px;}
            .manifest-form { padding: var(--sp-2); }
            .manifest-row { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--blue); padding-bottom: 8px;}
            .m-dots { display: none; }
            .m-value { align-self: flex-end; }
            .stamp-graphic { display: none; }
        }
    </style>
</head>

ORIGIN TRANSMISSIONS

THE INDEPENDENTS

Direct dispatches from the renegade wine farmers who refuse laboratory yeasts, copper oversprays, and wood chips.

01

“If the wine is clear, someone has killed it. The turbidity is the memory of the vineyard’s skin. If you want clear liquid, go buy municipal tap water.”

VÍTOR CLARO — DOMINÓ (COLARES & ALENTEJO)

“Our roots touch the salt line twice a day with the lunar cycle. The grapes don’t taste of fruit; they taste of dried iodine, cold Atlantic spray, and slate.”

DIANA SILVA — ILHA VINHOS (AÇORES)

“Sulfur is used by cowards who are afraid of what their vineyard actually did in October. We let the ferment run hot and pray to Saint Vincent.”

TIAGO SAMPAIO — FOLIAS DE BACO (ALTO DOURO)
04

“Industrial wine is an embalmed corpse. Natural wine is a fermentation bomb waiting to tell you about the rain storm that struck three months ago.”

ANTÓNIO MARQUES-DA-CRUZ — QUINTA DAS BÁGEIRAS (BAIRRADA)

brief: Booking system for independent climbing gyms
family: Art direction: Beta & Chalk. The raw, physical rigor of modern climbing meets Swiss grid typography. It treats routesetting, friction, and gym capacity with the tactical precision of high-performance athletic engineering.
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Beta & Chalk — Precision Operating System for Independent Climbing Gyms</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;700&family=Syne:wght@700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-basalt: #0D0E11;
      --text-chalk: #F4F4F0;
      --blaze-orange: #FF3B00;
      --slate-dust: #737880;
      --granite-card: #1C1E24;
      --granite-border: rgba(115, 120, 128, 0.28);
      --font-display: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      --font-text: 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
    }

    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      background-color: var(--bg-basalt);
      color: var(--text-chalk);
      font-family: var(--font-text);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.45;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    /* TYPOGRAPHY UTILITIES */
    .font-display {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    }

    .meta-tag {
      font-family: var(--font-text);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .v-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      background: #000000;
      color: #FFFFFF;
      border: 1px solid var(--blaze-orange);
      padding: 2px 7px;
      font-family: var(--font-text);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .v-badge.inverted {
      background: var(--blaze-orange);
      color: #000000;
      border-color: #000000;
    }

    /* GLOBAL BARRIER / BORDER LINE */
    .hairline-orange {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--blaze-orange);
    }
    .hairline-slate {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--granite-border);
    }

    /* TICKER HEADER */
    .top-telemetry {
      background: #050607;
      color: var(--slate-dust);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 9px 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--granite-border);
    }

    .top-telemetry-cluster {
      display: flex;
      gap: 28px;
    }

    .live-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      background: var(--blaze-orange);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: inline-block;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--blaze-orange);
      animation: pulse 1.8s infinite ease-in-out;
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.25; transform: scale(0.85); }
    }

    /* NAVIGATION */
    nav.master-nav {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 900;
      background: rgba(13, 14, 17, 0.94);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 280px 1fr auto;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 16px 28px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--granite-border);
    }

    .brand-logo {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 20px;
      color: var(--text-chalk);
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      text-decoration: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .brand-logo .slash {
      color: var(--blaze-orange);
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 32px;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      color: var(--text-chalk);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      transition: color 0.15s ease;
    }

    .nav-links a:hover {
      color: var(--blaze-orange);
    }

    .btn-action-sm {
      background: var(--text-chalk);
      color: #000;
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 10px 18px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .btn-action-sm:hover {
      background: var(--blaze-orange);
      color: #FFFFFF;
    }

    /* SECTION 1: HERO SYSTEM STATUS */
    .hero-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;
      min-height: calc(100vh - 80px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--blaze-orange);
    }

    .hero-editorial {
      padding: 56px 48px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--blaze-orange);
    }

    .hero-telemetry-banner {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding-bottom: 24px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--granite-border);
      color: var(--slate-dust);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(52px, 7.8vw, 114px);
      margin: 32px 0 24px 0;
      color: var(--text-chalk);
    }

    .hero-title span.orange {
      color: var(--blaze-orange);
      display: block;
    }

    .hero-paragraph-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 36px;
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding-top: 32px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--granite-border);
    }

    .hero-body-p {
      color: var(--text-chalk);
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .hero-stat-callout {
      background: var(--granite-card);
      padding: 20px;
      border-left: 3px solid var(--blaze-orange);
    }

    .hero-stat-callout .big-figure {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 38px;
      color: var(--text-chalk);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .hero-photo-half {
      position: relative;
      background: #000;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-photo-half img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: contrast(1.18) grayscale(0.2);
    }

    .photo-overlay-readout {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 24px;
      left: 24px;
      right: 24px;
      background: rgba(13, 14, 17, 0.92);
      border: 1px solid var(--granite-border);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    /* SECTION 2: LIVE HEATMAP & FLOW TICKER */
    .flow-section {
      padding: 80px 48px;
      background: var(--bg-basalt);
    }

    .section-header-compact {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-end;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      padding-bottom: 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--granite-border);
    }

    .section-header-compact h2 {
      font-size: clamp(24px, 3.5vw, 42px);
    }

    .zones-quad-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .zone-box {
      background: var(--granite-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--granite-border);
      padding: 24px;
      position: relative;
      transition: border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
    }

    .zone-box:hover {
      border-color: var(--blaze-orange);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .zone-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .zone-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 24px;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .zone-occupancy {
      font-size: 42px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
    }

    .occupancy-meter {
      height: 4px;
      background: #000;
      width: 100%;
      margin: 14px 0 20px 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .occupancy-fill {
      position: absolute;
      height: 100%;
      left: 0;
      top: 0;
      background: var(--blaze-orange);
    }

    .zone-tabular-data {
      list-style: none;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--slate-dust);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      padding-top: 14px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(115, 120, 128, 0.15);
    }

    .zone-tabular-data li {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .zone-tabular-data span.val {
      color: var(--text-chalk);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* SECTION 3: CORE BOOKING MATRIX (HIGH DENSITY UI IN ORANGE FIELD) */
    .field-orange-wrap {
      background: var(--blaze-orange);
      color: #000000;
      padding: 104px 48px;
    }

    .field-header {
      max-width: 900px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .field-header .meta-tag {
      color: #000000;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .field-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(40px, 6vw, 84px);
      color: #000000;
      margin-top: 12px;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    }

    .ui-floating-chassis {
      background: var(--bg-basalt);
      color: var(--text-chalk);
      border: 3px solid #000000;
      box-shadow: 20px 20px 0px #000000;
      max-width: 1320px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .chassis-chrome {
      background: #000000;
      padding: 14px 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    }

    .chassis-controls {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .chassis-control-dot {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #333338;
    }

    .chassis-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--slate-dust);
    }

    .matrix-content-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 310px 1fr;
    }

    .matrix-sidebar {
      background: var(--granite-card);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--granite-border);
      padding: 32px 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 28px;
    }

    .matrix-date-selector {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 26px;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .matrix-main-view {
      padding: 32px;
    }

    .time-slot-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .time-slot-table th {
      text-align: left;
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--slate-dust);
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--granite-border);
    }

    .time-slot-table td {
      padding: 16px 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(115, 120, 128, 0.18);
      vertical-align: middle;
    }

    .time-slot-table tr:hover td {
      background: rgba(255, 59, 0, 0.06);
    }

    .time-slot-table .time-col {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .status-capsule {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .status-capsule.avail {
      background: rgba(255, 59, 0, 0.15);
      color: var(--blaze-orange);
      border: 1px solid var(--blaze-orange);
    }

    .status-capsule.capped {
      background: #2a2c33;
      color: var(--slate-dust);
      border: 1px solid #3d414a;
    }

    .slot-action-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--text-chalk);
      color: var(--text-chalk);
      padding: 7px 14px;
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font-text);
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .slot-action-btn:hover {
      background: var(--blaze-orange);
      border-color: var(--blaze-orange);
      color: #FFFFFF;
    }

    /* SECTION 4: ROUTE SETTING CYCLES */
    .routes-section {
      padding: 96px 48px;
      background: var(--bg-basalt);
    }

    .routes-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-end;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .routes-trio {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .route-card {
      position: relative;
      background: var(--granite-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--granite-border);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .route-card-img-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      height: 480px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #000;
    }

    .route-card-img-wrap img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: transform 0.4s ease;
      filter: contrast(1.15) grayscale(0.15);

    .route-card:hover .route-card-img-wrap img {

    .route-floating-pill {

      right: 16px;
      background: #000000;
      color: var(--blaze-orange);
      border: 1px solid var(--blaze-orange);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    </section>

    <!-- 6. GYM OPERATOR MANIFESTO -->
    <section class="manifesto-section" id="manifesto">

          <div style="margin-top: 32px; display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;">

  </main>

  <!-- MASTER FOOTER -->
  <footer class="master-footer">
    <div class="footer-grid">
      <div class="footer-col">
        <a href="#" class="brand-logo" style="margin-bottom: 16px;">

      <div class="footer-col">
        <h4>SPECIFICATIONS</h4>

          <li><a href="#">GDPR & Vaulting</a></li>
          <li><a href="#">API Documentation</a></li>
        </ul>

        <h4>DIRECT TERMINAL</h4>

          Got an unusual wall setup or custom turnstile bus?
        </p>
        <span class="meta-tag" style="color: var(--blaze-orange);">SUPPORT@BETACHALK.IO</span>
        <div style="margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px;">+41 44 288 90 12 (ZÜRICH OPS)</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-bottom-bar">
      <div>© 2025 BETA & CHALK AG. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED. HIGH FRICTION INFRASTRUCTURE.</div>
      <div class="meta-tag">LATENCY: 12MS // STATUS: NORMAL</div>
    </div>
  </footer>

  <!-- DYNAMIC PRICING SCRIPT -->
  <script>
    const slider = document.getElementById('memberSlider');
    const memberDisplay = document.getElementById('memberDisplay');
    const priceDisplay = document.getElementById('priceDisplay');

    function updatePricing() {
      const val = parseInt(slider.value, 10);
      memberDisplay.textContent = val.toLocaleString() + ' CLIMBERS';
      
      // Tier pricing model
      let basePrice = 180;
      if (val <= 300) {
        basePrice = 180;
      } else if (val <= 800) {
        basePrice = 299;
      } else if (val <= 1500) {
        basePrice = 449;
      } else {
        basePrice = 649;
      }
      priceDisplay.textContent = '$' + basePrice;
    }

    slider.addEventListener('input', updatePricing);
  </script>

family: Art direction: PYROCLAST: Vitrified Geology. Tableware treated not as cozy domestic craft, but as raw volcanic geology tamed by heat. The aesthetic pulls from brutalist mineralogy, tactile macro-textures, and high-contrast editorial specimen catalogs.
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>PYROCLAST — Vitrified Geology / Firing 014</title>
  
  <!-- Typography -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Space+Mono:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=Syne:wght@700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-carbon: #0F0F11;
      --fg-chalk: #F4F1EA;
      --cinnabar: #FF3E14;
      --sludge-basalt: #3A3D36;
      --ash-patina: #8A9188;
      
      --font-display: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      --font-body: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      --font-mono: 'Space Mono', monospace;

      --border-thin: 1px solid var(--sludge-basalt);
      --border-cinnabar: 1px solid var(--cinnabar);
    }

    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      background-color: var(--bg-carbon);
      color: var(--fg-chalk);
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      text-rendering: geometricPrecision;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      overflow-x: hidden;
      width: 100%;
      background-color: var(--bg-carbon);
    }

    /* Common Micro-typography */
    .mono-label {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ash-patina);
    }

    .tabular {
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    /* Navigation / Operational Bar */
    header.manifest-nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      z-index: 100;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr auto;
      border-bottom: var(--border-thin);
      background: rgba(15, 15, 17, 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 52px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .brand-mark {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 18px;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      color: var(--fg-chalk);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .brand-mark::before {
      content: '';
      display: inline-block;
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--cinnabar);
    }

    .telemetry-tape {
      display: flex;
      gap: 32px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--ash-patina);
    }

    .telemetry-item span {
      color: var(--fg-chalk);
      margin-left: 6px;
    }

    .nav-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .btn-fire {
      background: var(--cinnabar);
      color: var(--fg-chalk);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border: none;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .btn-fire:hover {
      background: #e0320a;
    }

    /* SECTION 1: HERO / THE FIRING MANIFEST */
    section.hero-manifest {
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding-top: 52px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      position: relative;
      border-bottom: var(--border-thin);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-editorial-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      position: relative;
      flex-grow: 1;
      align-items: center;
      justify-items: center;
      padding: 60px 24px 40px;
    }

    .monument-headline {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 11vw, 13rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      line-height: 0.85;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--fg-chalk);
      position: absolute;
      width: 100%;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
      mix-blend-mode: difference;
      padding: 0 16px;
      word-break: break-word;
    }

    .hero-specimen-anchor {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      width: min(540px, 80vw);
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .specimen-img-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      position: relative;
      border: var(--border-thin);
      background: #141416;
      box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .specimen-img-wrap img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: contrast(1.1) brightness(0.95);
      transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .specimen-img-wrap:hover img {
      transform: scale(1.04);
    }

    /* Real-time Stamped SVG Reticle */
    .reticle-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--ash-patina);
      z-index: 3;
    }

    .reticle-top, .reticle-bot {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      width: 100%;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .crosshair {
      position: absolute;
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    }

    .crosshair::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 7px;
      left: 0;
      width: 16px;
      height: 1px;
      background: rgba(255, 62, 20, 0.6);
    }

    .crosshair::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 7px;
      top: 0;
      width: 1px;
      height: 16px;
      background: rgba(255, 62, 20, 0.6);
    }

    .hero-footer-ledger {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      border-top: var(--border-thin);
      background: #0B0B0C;
      z-index: 10;
    }

    .ledger-cell {
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border-right: var(--border-thin);
    }

    .ledger-cell:last-child {
      border-right: none;
    }

    .ledger-val {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--fg-chalk);
      margin-top: 4px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
    }

    /* SECTION 2: ARCHIVE SPECIMEN SHELF (4-COL WIREFRAME GRID) */
    section.specimen-shelf {
      border-bottom: var(--border-thin);
    }

    .shelf-header {
      padding: 32px 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-end;
      border-bottom: var(--border-thin);
    }

    .shelf-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .specimen-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      width: 100%;
    }

    .specimen-quadrant {
      position: relative;
      border-right: var(--border-thin);
      border-bottom: var(--border-thin);
      padding: 24px;
      min-height: 520px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      background: var(--bg-carbon);
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
      transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .specimen-quadrant:nth-child(4n) {
      border-right: none;
    }

    .quad-top {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .quad-id {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .quad-stock-pill {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 10px;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border: 1px solid currentColor;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .quad-image-well {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 1/1;
      position: relative;
      margin: auto 0;
      background: #151518;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: var(--border-thin);
    }

    .quad-image-well img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: grayscale(20%);
      transition: filter 0.2s ease, transform 0.4s ease;
    }

    .quad-bot {
      margin-top: 24px;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .quad-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .quad-formula {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      opacity: 0.7;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .quad-price-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: baseline;
      padding-top: 12px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }

    .quad-price {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* THE HOVER FLOOD IN SIGNATURE CINNABAR */
    .specimen-quadrant:hover {
      background-color: var(--cinnabar) !important;
      color: #0F0F11 !important;
      border-color: #0F0F11;
    }

    .specimen-quadrant:hover .mono-label {
      color: #0F0F11;
    }

    .specimen-quadrant:hover .quad-formula {
      color: #0F0F11;
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .specimen-quadrant:hover .quad-image-well {
      border-color: #0F0F11;
    }

    .specimen-quadrant:hover .quad-image-well img {
      filter: grayscale(0%) contrast(1.15);
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    .specimen-quadrant:hover .quad-price-row {

      flex-direction: column;

      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      background: #17181a;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: var(--border-thin);

      height: 100%;

      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      border-top: var(--border-thin);
      padding-top: 16px;

      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      text-transform: uppercase;

    .fault-chem-formula {

      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--cinnabar);

      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      z-index: 10;
      position: relative;
    }

    .kiln-feed-container {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 70vh;
      min-height: 500px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .kiln-feed-container img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: saturate(1.2) contrast(1.2) brightness(0.9);
    }

    .chamber-telemetry-hud {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 24px;
      pointer-events: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      z-index: 5;
    }

    .hud-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .hud-pill {
      background: rgba(15, 15, 17, 0.85);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 62, 20, 0.4);
      padding: 8px 14px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .live-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--cinnabar);
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--cinnabar);
      animation: pulse 1.2s infinite ease-in-out;

      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0.3; }

      gap: 12px;

      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-weight: 700;

      background: #d62d08;

    footer.studio-colophon {
      background: #0a0a0b;
      padding: 60px 24px 24px;
      border-top: var(--border-thin);
    }

    .colophon-grid {

      gap: 32px;
      padding-bottom: 60px;

    .colophon-col h5 {

      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--ash-patina);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .colophon-col p, .colophon-col li {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--fg-chalk);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .colophon-col ul {
      list-style: none;
    }

    .colophon-col ul li {
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .stamp-terminal {
      border-top: var(--border-thin);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--ash-patina);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    }

    /* RESPONSIVE DESIGN */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .specimen-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
      .specimen-quadrant:nth-child(2n) {
        border-right: none;
      }
      .chemical-breakdown {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .mineralogy-sticky-side {
        position: static;
        height: auto;
        border-right: none;
        border-bottom: var(--border-thin);
        padding: 48px 24px;
      }
      .colophon-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      header.manifest-nav {
        grid-template-columns: auto auto;
        padding: 0 16px;
      }
      .telemetry-tape {
        display: none;
      }
      .hero-footer-ledger {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
      .ledger-cell:nth-child(2) {
        border-right: none;
      }
      .ledger-cell:nth-child(3) {
        border-top: var(--border-thin);
      }
      .ledger-cell:nth-child(4) {
        border-top: var(--border-thin);
        border-right: none;
      }
      .specimen-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .specimen-quadrant {
        border-right: none;
      }
      .ticket-specs-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 16px;
      }
      .auth-input-group {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .btn-claim {
        padding: 16px;
      }
      .colophon-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .stamp-terminal {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 12px;
        align-items: flex-start;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

      <span>CONE 10 REDUCTION VITRIFIED STONEWARE</span>

    </div>
  </footer>

  <script>
    // Signature Detail: Reticle cursor tracker inside Hero Specimen Frame
    const specimen = document.getElementById('specimenAnchor');
    if (specimen) {
      specimen.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        const rect = specimen.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
        const cross = specimen.querySelector('.crosshair');
        if (cross) {
          cross.style.left = `${x}px`;
          cross.style.top = `${y}px`;
        }
      });

      specimen.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        const cross = specimen.querySelector('.crosshair');
        if (cross) {
          cross.style.left = '50%';
          cross.style.top = '50%';
        }
      });
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

brief: Open-source observability agent for Kubernetes clusters
family: Art direction: Subterranean Signal. Kubernetes isn't a cloud in the sky; it's industrial, physical plumbing running beneath massive pressure. We treat observability not as pretty dashboards, but as seismographic telemetry measuring tectonic infrastructure shifts.
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>SUBTERRANEAN // K8S Kernel Seismic Telemetry</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,700;1,400&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-obsidian: #0D0F12;
      --text-concrete: #F4F5F6;
      --hazard-orange: #FF3B00;
      --steel-plate: #1E232B;
      --readout-green: #50E3C2;
      --hairline: rgba(244, 245, 246, 0.14);
      --font-display: 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    body {
      background-color: var(--bg-obsidian);
      color: var(--text-concrete);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      letter-spacing: 0;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* RASTER OVERLAY FOR SUB-SURFACE TEXTURE */
    body::before {
      content: "";
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, transparent 60%, rgba(5,6,8,0.85)),
                  repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15) 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 2px);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 999;
    }

    /* TYPOGRAPHY SCALE */
    h1, h2, h3, h4, .display-text {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 0.92;
    }

    /* CONTINUOUS SEISMIC WAVE DIVIDER */
    .seismic-divider {
      width: 100%;
      height: 28px;
      position: relative;
      background-color: var(--bg-obsidian);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline);
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .seismic-divider canvas {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block;
    }
    .seismic-divider .freq-badge {
      position: absolute;
      right: 24px;
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--hazard-orange);
      background: var(--bg-obsidian);
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border: 1px solid var(--hazard-orange);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* MASTHEAD / INDUSTRIAL HEADER */
    header.sub-masthead {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr auto;
      align-items: center;
      background: rgba(13, 15, 18, 0.95);
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }
    .brand-mark {
      padding: 18px 24px;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--hairline);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: var(--text-concrete);
    }
    .brand-glyph {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      background: var(--hazard-orange);
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 59, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .brand-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .status-stream {
      padding: 0 24px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--readout-green);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .live-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--readout-green);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: pulse 1.4s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.2; transform: scale(0.85); }
    }
    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--hairline);
    }
    .header-btn {
      padding: 18px 28px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-concrete);
      text-decoration: none;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--hairline);
      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    }
    .header-btn:last-child {
      border-right: none;
      background: var(--hazard-orange);
      color: #000;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .header-btn:hover {
      background: var(--steel-plate);
    }
    .header-btn:last-child:hover {
      background: #e03400;
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* SECTION 1: HERO MONOLITH */
    .hero-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 58% 42%;
      min-height: calc(100vh - 58px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline);
    }
    .hero-typography {
      padding: 56px 48px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--hairline);
    }
    .spec-ledger {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #7b828d;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      display: flex;
      gap: 32px;
    }
    .spec-ledger span {
      color: var(--hazard-orange);
    }
    .hero-headline {
      font-size: clamp(48px, 6.2vw, 114px);
      line-height: 0.90;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      color: var(--text-concrete);
    }
    .hero-headline em {
      font-style: normal;
      color: var(--hazard-orange);
    }
    .hero-statement {
      max-width: 620px;
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.65;
      color: #a4abb5;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .hero-meta-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline);
      padding-top: 24px;
    }
    .hero-meta-item .metric-label {
      font-size: 10px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #656d78;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .hero-meta-item .metric-val {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-concrete);
    }

    /* HERO TERMINAL PANE */
    .hero-terminal {
      background: #08090b;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      border-left: 2px solid var(--hazard-orange);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .terminal-chrome {
      padding: 12px 20px;
      background: var(--steel-plate);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #9aa1ab;
    }
    .terminal-body {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 24px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      line-height: 1.55;
      color: #c4cad4;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
    }
    .terminal-body pre {
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      word-break: break-all;
    }
    .probe-tag {
      color: var(--hazard-orange);
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .probe-ok {
      color: var(--readout-green);
    }
    .probe-dim {
      color: #434b56;
    }
    .probe-hl {
      background: rgba(255, 59, 0, 0.15);
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* SECTION 2: PROOF OF FOOTPRINT */
    .footprint-section {
      padding: 96px 0 0 0;
      background: var(--bg-obsidian);
    }
    .section-header-block {
      padding: 0 48px 48px 48px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 280px 1fr;
      gap: 32px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline);
    }
    .section-id {
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      color: var(--hazard-orange);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .section-title-large {
      font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 56px);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .benchmark-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline);
    }
    .bench-card {
      padding: 48px 36px 0 36px;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--hairline);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .bench-card:last-child {
      border-right: none;
    }
    .bench-card.flagship {
      background: rgba(255, 59, 0, 0.04);
    }
    .bench-tag {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      display: inline-block;

    @media (max-width: 1024px) {

        grid-template-columns: 1fr;

        min-height: 480px;

        grid-template-columns: 1fr;

        grid-template-columns: 1fr;

        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }
      .hardware-gallery {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .gallery-tile {
        border-right: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      header.sub-masthead {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;

      .status-stream {
        display: none;
      }
      .hero-typography {
        padding: 36px 20px;

      .section-header-block {

      .btn-copy-install {
        margin-left: 0;

      .install-flags {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 8px;

        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .sub-footer-bar {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 16px;
        align-items: flex-start;
      }

</head>

        canvas,
        ctx,
        offset: Math.random() * 100,
        speed: 1.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
        spikeTimer: Math.floor(Math.random() * 60)
      });
    });

    function resizeCanvases() {
      canvases.forEach(canvas => {
        canvas.width = canvas.parentElement.clientWidth;
        canvas.height = 28;
      });
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvases);
    resizeCanvases();

    function renderSeismographs() {
      seismicStates.forEach((item) => {
        const { canvas, ctx } = item;
        const w = canvas.width;
        const h = canvas.height;
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

        ctx.strokeStyle = '#FF3B00';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.beginPath();

        item.offset += item.speed;
        item.spikeTimer--;

        let isSpiking = false;
        if (item.spikeTimer <= 0) {
          isSpiking = true;
          if (item.spikeTimer < -15) {
            item.spikeTimer = Math.floor(60 + Math.random() * 120);
          }
        }

        const midY = h / 2;
        for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 4) {
          const wavePhase = (x + item.offset) * 0.04;
          let amp = Math.sin(wavePhase) * 2;
          
          // Inject micro-jitters
          amp += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.5;

          // Violent tectonic spikes simulating pod network burst
          if (isSpiking && x > w * 0.4 && x < w * 0.6) {
            amp += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 18;
          }

          const y = midY + amp;
          if (x === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
          else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      });

      requestAnimationFrame(renderSeismographs);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(renderSeismographs);

    // 2. LIVE TERMINAL LOG STREAM EMITTER (HERO)
    const logBox = document.getElementById('streamCode');
    const logPool = [
      "bpf_trace: epoll_wait unblocked for conn fd=81 rtt=91ns",
      "sock_ops: TCP_ESTABLISHED -> pod=checkout-api-49b node=worker-09",
      ">> HARNESS PULSE: 48,110 bpf events parsed cleanly in 12ms",

      "kprobe/__netif_receive_skb_core: bypass tc queue success",
      "tracepoint/timer/timer_start: bpf_heartbeat interval=1000us"
    ];

    setInterval(() => {
      if (!logBox) return;
      const lines = logBox.innerHTML.trim().split('\n');
      if (lines.length > 20) lines.shift();

      const timeSec = (performance.now() / 1000).toFixed(6);
      const randomMsg = logPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * logPool.length)];
      lines.push(`[${timeSec}] ${randomMsg}`);
      logBox.innerHTML = lines.join('\n');
    }, 450);

    // 3. COPY HELM INSTALLATION CLIPBOARD ACTION
    function copySnippet(btn) {
      const code = "helm repo add subterranean https://helm.subterranean.sh && helm install seismic subterranean/agent -n kube-system --set kernel.tcDirect=true";
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {

        btn.style.color = "#000";
        setTimeout(() => {
          btn.innerText = "COPY RUNTIME";
          btn.style.background = "var(--hazard-orange)";

    }

    // 4. DIAGRAM SCRUB BAR INTERACTIVITY
    function setDiagramStep(step) {

      font-size: 0.82rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;

      transition: border-color 0.2s ease;

    .btn-ghost:hover {
      border-color: var(--green);
      color: var(--green);

    /* =========================================================

       ========================================================= */

      grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);

    .hero-panel-left {

      flex-direction: column;

      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.2vw, 5.2rem);

      color: var(--text-muted);

      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;

      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;

      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--text);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .scrubber-track {
      width: 100%;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--border-dark);
      outline: none;
      cursor: ew-resize;
      margin: 1rem 0;

    .scrubber-track::-webkit-slider-thumb {
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      background: var(--green);

      box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--green);

    .scrubber-meta {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-top: 1rem;
      padding-top: 0.75rem;

    .scrubber-col small {

      font-size: 0.65rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;

    .scrubber-col span {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .hero-panel-right {
      position: relative;
      background: #0D1016;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .hero-img-container {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 480px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero-img-container img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: saturate(0.85) contrast(1.15);
    }

    .thermal-callout {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 2rem;
      left: 2rem;
      right: 2rem;
      background: rgba(19, 23, 31, 0.92);
      border: 1px solid var(--green);
      padding: 1.25rem;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);

    .thermal-callout-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: center;

    .badge-temp {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    /* =========================================================
       SECTION 2: THE METABOLIC DROP INDEX (TELEMETRY STRIPS)
       ========================================================= */
    .section-telemetry {
      padding: 7rem 3.5rem;
      background: var(--bg);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .section-header-block {
      max-width: 900px;
      margin-bottom: 4rem;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.8vw, 3.8rem);
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1.05;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin: 0.5rem 0 1.25rem;

    .strips-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1px;
      background: var(--border);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .telemetry-strip {
      background: var(--surface);
      padding: 1.75rem 2.25rem;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 140px 1.2fr 1fr 140px;
      gap: 2rem;
      align-items: center;
      transition: all 0.25s ease;
      cursor: crosshair;
    }

    .telemetry-strip:hover {
      background: #171E28;
      border-left: 4px solid var(--green);
      padding-left: calc(2.25rem - 4px);
    }

    .telemetry-time {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .telemetry-phase h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    }

    .telemetry-phase p {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .telemetry-delta {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      background: #090B0E;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
      padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
    }

    .delta-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    }

    .delta-row:last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .bad { color: #FF6B6B; }
    .good { color: var(--green); }

    .telemetry-action {
      text-align: right;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    /* =========================================================
       SECTION 3: BREAKROOM PROOF (PHOTO ESSAY & VOICES)
       ========================================================= */
    .section-proof {
      padding: 7rem 3.5rem;
      background: var(--surface);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .proof-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 2rem;
      margin-top: 3.5rem;
    }

    .proof-card {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .proof-photo-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 380px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .proof-photo-wrapper img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: grayscale(20%) contrast(1.15);
      transition: transform 0.4s ease;
    }

    .proof-card:hover .proof-photo-wrapper img {
      transform: scale(1.03);
    }

    .proof-hud-stamp {
      position: absolute;
      top: 1rem;
      left: 1rem;
      background: rgba(9, 11, 14, 0.85);
      padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .proof-content {
      padding: 2rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      flex-grow: 1;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .nurse-quote {
      font-size: 0.98rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .nurse-signature {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
      padding-top: 1.25rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
    }

    .nurse-name {
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      display: block;
    }

    .nurse-ward {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      display: block;
      margin-top: 0.2rem;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       SECTION 4: FULL-FIELD GREEN BANNER / PACK ARCHITECTURE
       ========================================================= */
    .section-pack {
      background: var(--green);
      color: #000;
      padding: 6.5rem 3.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .pack-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 4rem;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .pack-header-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4.4vw, 4.4rem);
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 0.95;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin: 0.75rem 0 1.5rem;
    }

    .pack-lead {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      font-weight: 500;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      max-width: 44ch;
    }

    .specs-list {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      border-top: 2px solid #000;
      padding-top: 2rem;
    }

    .spec-item {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2.5rem 1fr;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .spec-num {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }

    .spec-body strong {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    }

    .spec-body p {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.45;
      opacity: 0.85;
    }

    .pack-visual {
      position: relative;
      background: #000;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: 20px 20px 0 #000;
    }

    .pack-visual img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 480px;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
    }

    .pack-visual-caption {
      margin-top: 1rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      color: var(--green);
      background: #000;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       SECTION 5: SHIFT-ADAPTIVE MENU CAROUSEL
       ========================================================= */
    .section-menu {
      padding: 7rem 3.5rem;
      background: var(--bg);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .menu-cards-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 2rem;
      margin-top: 3.5rem;
    }

    .menu-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .menu-card-num {
      position: absolute;
      top: -1.5rem;
      right: 1rem;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 5rem;
      color: rgba(230, 236, 242, 0.04);
      z-index: 1;
      line-height: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .menu-photo {
      width: 100%;
      height: 260px;
      position: relative;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
    }

    .menu-photo img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: saturate(0.9);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    .menu-card:hover .menu-photo img {
      transform: scale(1.04);
    }

    .menu-card-body {
      padding: 2rem;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      flex-grow: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .meal-phase-tag {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--green);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      display: block;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }

    .meal-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    .meal-desc {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .macro-strip {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 0.5rem;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
      padding: 0.75rem;
      text-align: center;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
    }

    .macro-strip small {
      display: block;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .macro-strip span {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    /* =========================================================
       SECTION 6: THE WARD ROSTER (SUBSCRIPTION MATRIX)
       ========================================================= */
    .section-roster {
      padding: 7rem 3.5rem;
      background: var(--bg);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .roster-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 2rem;
      margin-top: 3.5rem;
    }

    .roster-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 2.75rem 2.25rem 2.25rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      position: relative;
      transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .roster-card:hover, .roster-card.featured {
      border-color: var(--green);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 255, 133, 0.08);
