    .roster-card.featured::before {
      content: "PRE-STATION DEFAULT";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: var(--green);
      color: #000;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0.35rem 0;
    }

    .roster-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.7rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .roster-price {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 2.5rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 1.25rem 0 0.5rem;
    }

    .roster-price span {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .roster-sub {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }

    .roster-features {
      list-style: none;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
      padding-top: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.85rem;
    }

    .roster-features li {
      font-size: 0.86rem;
      color: var(--text);
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .roster-features li::before {
      content: "■";
      color: var(--green);
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      margin-top: 0.2rem;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       SECTION 7: FOOTER / STANDBY TERMINAL
       ========================================================= */
    .terminal-footer {
      background: #050709;
      padding: 5rem 3.5rem 3rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .terminal-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1.5fr;
      gap: 3rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
      padding-bottom: 4rem;
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
    }

    .terminal-block h5 {
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .terminal-block p {
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .subsidy-code-box {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px dashed var(--border);
      padding: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--green);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
    }

    .footer-countdown {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 1.5rem;
    }

    .countdown-val {
      font-size: 1.75rem;
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 700;
      display: block;
      margin: 0.5rem 0;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .terminal-bottom {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       RESPONSIVE ADAPTATIONS
       ========================================================= */
    @media (max-width: 1080px) {
      .section-hero {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .hero-panel-left {
        border-right: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        padding: 3.5rem 2rem;
      }
      .pack-grid,
      .proof-grid,
      .menu-cards-row,
      .roster-grid,
      .terminal-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .telemetry-strip {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 1rem;
      }
      .hud-header {
        padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      }
      .telemetry-ticker {
        display: none;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .section-hero,
      .section-telemetry,
      .section-proof,
      .section-pack,
      .section-menu,
      .section-roster,
      .terminal-footer {
        padding: 3.5rem 1.25rem;
      }
      .hero-headline {
        font-size: 2.3rem;
      }
      .hero-actions {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
      }
      .btn-tactical, .btn-ghost {
        width: 100%;
        text-align: center;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

  <script>
    // Shift scrubber interaction
    const slider = document.getElementById('shift-slider');
    const timeVal = document.getElementById('scrubber-time-val');
    const phaseName = document.getElementById('scrubber-phase-name');
    const cortisol = document.getElementById('meta-cortisol');
    const temp = document.getElementById('meta-temp');
    const meal = document.getElementById('meta-meal');

    const timelineData = [
      { hour: "19:00 PM", phase: "HOUR 00 // PRE-SHIFT INSERTION", cort: "Baseline Normal", temp: "37.0°C (Standard)", meal: "Slow Starch Primer" },
      { hour: "21:30 PM", phase: "HOUR 02 // ADMISSION SURGE", cort: "Mild Spiking", temp: "36.8°C (-0.2°)", meal: "Ginger Bone Matrix" },
      { hour: "00:00 AM", phase: "HOUR 05 // MIDNIGHT PLATEAU", cort: "Declining", temp: "36.5°C (-0.5°)", meal: "Bioavailable Peptides" },
      { hour: "02:45 AM", phase: "HOUR 07 // THE GLYCEMIC TROUGH", cort: "Suppressed / Flat", temp: "36.1°C (-0.9°)", meal: "Thermal Broth Core" },
      { hour: "04:30 AM", phase: "HOUR 09 // CRITICAL ALERT ZONE", cort: "Depleted", temp: "36.0°C (-1.0°)", meal: "Farro & Hen Micro-Cell" },
      { hour: "06:30 AM", phase: "HOUR 11 // HANDOFF & PRE-SLEEP", cort: "Rebounding (Spike)", temp: "36.3°C (-0.7°)", meal: "Tart Cherry Sleep Chelate" }
    ];

    slider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      const idx = Math.min(Math.floor((e.target.value / 12) * timelineData.length), timelineData.length - 1);
      const data = timelineData[idx];
      timeVal.textContent = data.hour;
      phaseName.textContent = data.phase;
      cortisol.textContent = data.cort;
      temp.textContent = data.temp;
      meal.textContent = data.meal;
    });

    // Real-time clock HUD simulation
    function updateHUD() {
      const now = new Date();
      const hours = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
      const minutes = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
      const seconds = String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
      
      let phase = "PRE-SHIFT PRIMING";
      const h = now.getHours();
      if (h >= 19 && h < 23) phase = "SHIFT INSERTION";
      else if (h >= 23 || h < 2) phase = "MIDNIGHT PLATEAU";
      else if (h >= 2 && h < 5) phase = "GLYCEMIC TROUGH [ALERT]";
      else if (h >= 5 && h < 8) phase = "HANDOFF EXTRACTION";
      else phase = "DAYLIGHT RECOVERY";

      const hudElem = document.getElementById('hud-phase-readout');
      if (hudElem) {
        hudElem.textContent = `PHASE: ${phase} [${hours}:${minutes}:${seconds}]`;
      }
    }
    setInterval(updateHUD, 1000);
    updateHUD();

    // Footer Countdown
    let timeRemaining = 4 * 3600 + 18 * 60 + 22;
    setInterval(() => {
      if (timeRemaining > 0) {
        timeRemaining--;
        const hrs = String(Math.floor(timeRemaining / 3600)).padStart(2, '0');
        const mins = String(Math.floor((timeRemaining % 3600) / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
        const secs = String(timeRemaining % 60).padStart(2, '0');
        document.getElementById('countdown-timer').textContent = `${hrs}:${mins}:${secs}`;
      }
    }, 1000);
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #0D0F11;

      --steel: #2B3238;

      margin: 0;

    }

    html {

      background-color: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1, "zero" 1;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;

      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);

      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }

    .brand-mark {
      padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .brand-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: var(--text);
      text-decoration: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .brand-title span.tag {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      background: var(--steel);
      padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem;
      color: var(--orange);
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: 1px;
    }

    nav.quick-nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    nav.quick-nav a {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--text);
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
    }

    nav.quick-nav a:hover {
      background: var(--steel);
      color: var(--orange);
    }

    /* MACHINE SERIAL PLATE (Top-Right Signature Detail) */
    .serial-plate {
      background: #171a1d;
      border-left: 2px solid var(--orange);
      padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, auto);
      gap: 1.25rem;
      align-items: center;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.68rem;
    }

    .plate-cell {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .plate-cell .label {
      color: var(--zinc);
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }

    .plate-cell .val {
      color: var(--text);
      font-weight: 600;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.35rem;
    }

    .plate-cell .pulse {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      background-color: var(--orange);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: pulse 1.5s infinite ease-in-out;
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.85); }
    }

    /* SECTION 1: LIVE WORKSHOP TELEMETRY HERO */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding-top: 5rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--orange);
    }

    .hero-media-wrapper {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-media-wrapper img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: grayscale(100%) contrast(125%) brightness(40%);
    }

    .hero-media-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(13,15,17,0.7) 0%, rgba(13,15,17,0.92) 100%);
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      padding: 4rem 3rem 2rem 3rem;
      max-width: 1400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .hero-badge-bar {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      color: var(--zinc);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
    }

    .hero-badge-bar .code-chip {
      background: var(--steel);
      color: var(--text);
      padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
      border-left: 3px solid var(--orange);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 7.5vw, 7.8rem);
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      max-width: 14ch;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .hero-title .accent-orange {
      color: var(--orange);
    }

    .hero-action-bar {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 2rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-top: 2rem;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .hero-lead-text {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: #d1d8dc;
      max-width: 48ch;
    }

    .telemetry-stat {
      border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-left: 1.25rem;
    }

    .telemetry-stat .num {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 2.2rem;
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .telemetry-stat .lbl {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      color: var(--zinc);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      margin-top: 0.35rem;
    }

    /* MASSIVE ORANGE TICKER BAR */
    .hero-ticker {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      background: var(--orange);
      color: #000;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0.85rem 0;
      box-shadow: 0 -8px 24px rgba(255, 77, 0, 0.25);
    }

    .ticker-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 3rem;
      animation: tickerRun 28s linear infinite;
    }

    @keyframes tickerRun {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    /* SECTION 2: PAYLOAD & PLATFORM INDEX */
    .platform-index {
      padding: 7rem 3rem;
      max-width: 1440px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .section-header-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-end;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
      padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 4.2rem);
    }

    .section-meta {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      color: var(--orange);
      text-align: right;
    }

    .platform-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 1.5px;
      background: var(--border);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .platform-card {
      background: var(--bg);
      padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      position: relative;
      transition: background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .platform-card:hover {
      background: #13171a;
    }

    .platform-card .index-num {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--zinc);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .platform-card .frame-img-box {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      background: var(--zinc-dark);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .platform-card .frame-img-box img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: grayscale(100%) contrast(120%);
      transition: transform 0.4s ease, filter 0.4s ease;
    }

    .platform-card:hover .frame-img-box img {
      filter: grayscale(40%) contrast(110%);
      transform: scale(1.04);
    }

    .platform-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .spec-table {
      width: 100%;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    .spec-table tr {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(115, 128, 138, 0.2);
    }

    .spec-table td {
      padding: 0.5rem 0;
      color: var(--zinc);
    }

    .spec-table td:last-child {
      text-align: right;
      color: var(--text);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* SECTION 3: THE HEAVY WORKSHOP PROTOCOL (STICKY ASYMMETRIC SPLIT) */
    .protocol-section {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: #111417;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 40% 60%;
    }

    .protocol-sticky-col {
      padding: 6rem 4rem;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      position: sticky;
      top: 5rem;
      height: calc(100vh - 5rem);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .protocol-sticky-col .badge {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      background: var(--orange);
      color: #000;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      width: fit-content;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .protocol-scroll-col {
      padding: 4rem 3rem;
    }

    .protocol-step-block {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      padding: 4rem 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .protocol-step-block:first-child {
      padding-top: 0;
    }

    .protocol-step-block:last-child {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .step-counter {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(4rem, 8vw, 7.5rem);
      color: var(--orange);
      line-height: 0.85;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .step-body-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
      gap: 2rem;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .step-info h3 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 2rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .step-info p {
      color: #aeb9c2;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    }

    .step-readouts {
      list-style: none;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-top: 0.75rem;
    }

    .step-readouts li {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0.35rem 0;
      color: var(--zinc);
    }

    .step-readouts li span {
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .step-photo {
      aspect-ratio: 4/5;
      background: var(--zinc-dark);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .step-photo img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: grayscale(100%) contrast(115%);
      transition: filter 0.3s ease;
    }

    .step-step-block:hover .step-photo img {
      filter: grayscale(20%);
    }

    /* SECTION 4: DIAGNOSTIC BAY VISUALIZER */
    .diagnostic-schematic {
      padding: 6rem 3rem;
      max-width: 1440px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .schematic-box {
      border: 1px solid var(--zinc);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #1b2024 0%, #0d0f11 100%);
      padding: 3rem;
      position: relative;
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }

    .grid-lines {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-size: 40px 40px;
      background-image: 
        linear-gradient(to right, rgba(115, 128, 138, 0.1) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(115, 128, 138, 0.1) 1px, transparent 1px);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .schematic-callout-grid {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    .tool-module {
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: rgba(13, 15, 17, 0.85);
      padding: 1.75rem;
      position: relative;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
    }

    .tool-module:hover {
      border-color: var(--orange);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .tool-module .axis-tag {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      color: var(--orange);
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      display: block;
    }

    .tool-module h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    .tool-module p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: #9aa7b1;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .tool-macro-visual {
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      background: #23282c;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .tool-macro-visual img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: grayscale(100%) contrast(130%);
      transition: filter 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    .tool-module:hover .tool-macro-visual img {
      filter: grayscale(0%) contrast(110%);
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    /* SECTION 5: EMERGENCY FLEET & FAMILY DISPATCH */
    .dispatch-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      min-height: 700px;
      border-top: 2px solid var(--orange);
    }

    .dispatch-slab-black {
      background: #090a0c;
      color: var(--text);
      padding: 5rem 4rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .dispatch-slab-orange {
      background: var(--orange);
      color: #000000;
      padding: 5rem 4rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .slab-header {
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
    }

    .slab-header .sub {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      display: block;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .dispatch-slab-black .sub {
      color: var(--zinc);
    }

    .dispatch-slab-orange .sub {
      color: #3b1200;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .dispatch-slab-black h2 {
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4.5vw, 4.5rem);
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .dispatch-slab-orange h2 {
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4.5vw, 4.5rem);
      color: #000;
    }

    .slab-specs-list {
      list-style: none;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
    }

    .slab-specs-list li {
      padding: 0.8rem 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .dispatch-slab-orange .slab-specs-list li {
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .btn-slab {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 1.15rem 2rem;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: center;
      text-decoration: none;
      display: inline-block;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
    }

    .btn-slab-black {
      background: var(--text);
      color: #000;
    }

    .btn-slab-black:hover {
      background: var(--orange);
      color: #000;
    }

    .btn-slab-orange {
      background: #000000;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .btn-slab-orange:hover {
      background: #2b3238;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    /* SECTION 6: HARBOR OUTPOST COORDINATES & MANIFEST FOOTER */
    footer.harbor-manifest {
      background: #08090a;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 6rem 3rem 2rem 3rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
    }

    .manifest-grid {
      max-width: 1440px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1.2fr 1fr 1.2fr;
      gap: 3rem;
      padding-bottom: 4rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .manifest-col h5 {
      color: var(--orange);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }

    .manifest-col p, .manifest-col address {
      font-style: normal;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: #b0bcc6;
    }

    .manifest-col address strong {
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    }

    .roster-list {
      list-style: none;
    }

    .roster-list li {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      padding: 0.35rem 0;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      color: #b0bcc6;
    }

    .roster-list li span.active-tag {
      color: var(--orange);
    }

    .barcode-container {
      margin-top: 4rem;
      padding-top: 2rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-end;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    .barcode-svg {
      height: 48px;
      width: 280px;
      fill: var(--zinc);
    }

    .manifest-footer-text {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      color: var(--zinc);
    }

    .manifest-huge-loc {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 11vw, 11rem);
      line-height: 0.8;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
      margin-top: 3rem;
      user-select: none;
      overflow: hidden;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* RESPONSIVE LAYOUT BREAKPOINTS */
    @media (max-width: 1100px) {
      .platform-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
      .protocol-section {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .protocol-sticky-col {
        position: relative;
        top: 0;
        height: auto;
        border-right: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        padding: 4rem 2rem;
      }
      .schematic-callout-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .dispatch-split {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .manifest-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      header.masthead {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      nav.quick-nav {
        display: none;
      }
      .serial-plate {
        border-left: none;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        justify-content: space-between;
      }
      .hero-content {
        padding: 5rem 1.5rem 2rem 1.5rem;
      }
      .hero-action-bar {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 1.5rem;
      }
      .telemetry-stat {
        border-left: none;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        padding-left: 0;
        padding-top: 1rem;
      }
      .platform-index {
        padding: 4rem 1.5rem;
      }
      .platform-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .step-body-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .diagnostic-schematic {
        padding: 4rem 1.5rem;
      }
      .schematic-box {
        padding: 1.5rem;
      }
      .dispatch-slab-black, .dispatch-slab-orange {
        padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem;
      }
      .manifest-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      footer.harbor-manifest {
        padding: 4rem 1.5rem 2rem 1.5rem;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

        <span>NORDHAVN PIER DOCK-IN DIRECT ACCESS FOR LONGTAILS</span>
        <span>/// CRANE & CHAIN MUNICIPAL HEAVY DIVISION</span>
        <span>STATUS: BAY 1 BUSHINGS // BAY 2 STEERING DAMPER CALIBRATION // BAY 3 BOSCH CARGO LINE MOTOR TEARDOWN</span>

brief: Note-taking app for PhD students that links papers to notes
family: Art direction: Marginalia & The Monograph. The software reimagined as an ultra-refined, permanent academic press. We elevate the doctoral thesis from disorganized digital scraps into living, typeset editorial literature.
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Marginalia & The Monograph — The Scholarly Press for Doctoral Theses</title>
  
  <!-- Typography -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=EB+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,600&family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,300;0,6..72,400;0,6..72,600;1,6..72,300;1,6..72,400;1,6..72,600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
    :root {
      --oxblood: #1B1714;
      --rag: #F4EFE6;
      --vermilion: #E05A2B;
      --leather: #4A3B32;
      --graphite: #8C827A;
      --pure-black: #0F0D0C;
      --vellum-tint: #ECE5D8;
      
      --font-display: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif;
      --font-body: 'EB Garamond', Garamond, Georgia, serif;
      --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      
      --gutter: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
      --max-width: 1480px;
    }

    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      background-color: var(--oxblood);
      color: var(--rag);
      font-size: 16px;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 1.1875rem;
      line-height: 1.625;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      background-color: var(--oxblood);
      color: var(--rag);
      font-feature-settings: "onum" 1, "kern" 1, "liga" 1;
    }

    /* Photographic Canvas Replacements */
    img[data-photo] {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: contrast(106%) brightness(96%) sepia(8%);
      transition: filter 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }
    img[data-photo]:hover {
      filter: contrast(108%) brightness(102%) sepia(2%);
    }

    /* Smallcaps & Microtypography */
    .marginal-note {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-variant-caps: all-small-caps;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--graphite);
    }

    .vermilion-callout {
      color: var(--vermilion);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* Navigation */
    .masthead {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--leather);
      padding: 1.25rem var(--gutter);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      background-color: rgba(27, 23, 20, 0.94);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      z-index: 100;
    }

    .masthead-brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: 1rem;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: var(--rag);
    }

    .brand-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .brand-stamp {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      background: var(--leather);
      color: var(--rag);
      padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
      border-radius: 2px;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }

    .nav-folio {
      display: flex;
      gap: 2rem;
      list-style: none;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .nav-folio a {
      color: var(--rag);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-variant-caps: all-small-caps;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      transition: color 0.2s ease;
    }

    .nav-folio a:hover {
      color: var(--vermilion);
    }

    .btn-quire {
      background-color: var(--vermilion);
      color: var(--rag);
      border: 1px solid var(--vermilion);
      padding: 0.55rem 1.4rem;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-variant-caps: all-small-caps;
      letter-spacing: 0.15em;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.25s ease;
    }

    .btn-quire:hover {
      background-color: transparent;
      color: var(--vermilion);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--vermilion);
    }

    /* Section 1: The Frontispiece (Hero) */
    .frontispiece {
      padding: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 6rem) var(--gutter);
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 3rem;
      position: relative;
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .frontispiece {
        grid-template-columns: 5fr 7fr;
        align-items: start;
        gap: 5rem;
      }
    }

    .frontispiece-thesis {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.75rem;
    }

    .edition-tag {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--vermilion);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    }
    .edition-tag::before {
      content: "§";
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--vermilion);
    }

    .frontispiece-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 6.2vw, 5.25rem);
      line-height: 1.05;
      font-weight: 300;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    }

    .frontispiece-title em {
      font-style: italic;
      color: var(--rag);
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    .frontispiece-lead {
      font-size: 1.3125rem;
      line-height: 1.55;
      color: var(--rag);
      opacity: 0.92;
      max-width: 38ch;
      border-left: 2px solid var(--leather);
      padding-left: 1.25rem;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
    }

    .frontispiece-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }

    .spec-sheet-link {
      color: var(--graphite);
      font-variant-caps: all-small-caps;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-underline-offset: 5px;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .spec-sheet-link:hover {
      color: var(--rag);
    }

    /* Interactive Hero Spine Stack */
    .hero-stack-stage {
      position: relative;
      background: #15110F;
      border: 1px solid var(--leather);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }

    .hero-photo-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(244, 239, 230, 0.08);
    }

    .tome-spine-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    .tome-entry {
      background: rgba(244, 239, 230, 0.03);
      border: 1px solid var(--leather);
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.25s ease;
      position: relative;
    }

    .tome-entry:hover, .tome-entry.active {
      background: rgba(224, 90, 43, 0.1);
      border-color: var(--vermilion);
      transform: translateX(6px);
    }

    .tome-ref-code {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--vermilion);
    }

    .tome-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .tome-marginalia-count {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-variant-caps: all-small-caps;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      color: var(--graphite);
    }

    /* Live Vermilion Ribbon Indicator */
    .ribbon-overlay-note {
      background: var(--vermilion);
      color: var(--rag);
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -1rem;
      right: 1.5rem;
      max-width: 280px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      z-index: 10;
    }

    /* Section 2: The Critical Apparatus (Direct PDF Ingestion) */
    .apparatus-section {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--leather);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--leather);
      background-color: #161210;
      padding: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 6rem) var(--gutter);
    }

    .apparatus-container {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .apparatus-header {
      margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    @media (min-width: 900px) {
      .apparatus-header {
        grid-template-columns: 4fr 8fr;
        align-items: end;
      }
    }

    .section-eyebrow {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--vermilion);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .apparatus-header h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4vw, 3.75rem);
      font-weight: 300;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .apparatus-header p {
      color: var(--graphite);
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      max-width: 50ch;
    }

    /* Direct PDF vs Markdown Split Engine */
    .apparatus-viewport {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      border: 1px solid var(--leather);
      background: #110E0D;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 0 40px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .apparatus-viewport {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }
    }

    .pane-pdf {
      padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3rem);
      background: #F4EFE6;
      color: #1A1715;
      position: relative;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      line-height: 1.55;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--leather);
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .pane-pdf {
        border-bottom: none;
        border-right: 1px solid var(--leather);
      }
    }

    .pdf-meta-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(27, 23, 20, 0.2);
      padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: #5C524A;
    }

    .pdf-arxiv-title {
      font-family: 'Newsreader', serif;
      font-size: 1.625rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.25;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      color: #1A1715;
    }

    .pdf-authors {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: #5A524C;
      font-style: italic;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .pdf-two-column {
      column-count: 2;
      column-gap: 1.5rem;
      text-align: justify;
      position: relative;
    }

    .pdf-two-column p {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .pdf-underlined-target {
      background: rgba(224, 90, 43, 0.18);
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--vermilion);
      padding: 0 2px;
      position: relative;
      cursor: help;
    }

    .math-slug {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      padding: 0.2rem 0.4rem;
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      display: inline-block;
      margin: 0.4rem 0;
      border-left: 2px solid var(--vermilion);
    }

    .pane-monograph {
      padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3rem);
      background: #171311;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .monograph-editor-top {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--vermilion);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--leather);
      padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }

    .editor-body {
      font-size: 1.1875rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--rag);
    }

    .editor-body h3 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.75rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .editor-body p {
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .live-cite-capsule {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      background: var(--leather);
      color: var(--rag);
      padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      border-radius: 2px;
      border-left: 2px solid var(--vermilion);
    }

    .monograph-footnotes {
      margin-top: 2rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--leather);
      padding-top: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--graphite);
    }

    .monograph-footnotes ol {
      padding-left: 1.25rem;
    }

    .monograph-footnotes li {
      margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
    }

    /* Section 3: Topological Index (Graph System) */
    .topological-section {
      min-height: 100vh;
      background-color: var(--pure-black);
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 6rem) var(--gutter);
      overflow: hidden;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--leather);
    }

    .topological-heading-layer {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 5;
      max-width: 60ch;
    }

    .topological-heading-layer h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
      font-weight: 300;
      line-height: 1.05;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
    }

    /* Constellation Map Simulation Canvas */
    .constellation-field {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .graph-node-container {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 5;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 2rem;
      margin: 4rem 0;
    }

    .chapter-node-card {
      background: rgba(27, 23, 20, 0.85);
      border: 1px solid var(--leather);
      padding: 1.75rem;
      position: relative;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .chapter-node-card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: -6px;
      left: 1.75rem;
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      background-color: var(--vermilion);
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--vermilion);
    }

    .chapter-node-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--vermilion);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .node-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--vermilion);
    }

    .chapter-node-card h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .chapter-node-card p {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--graphite);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .topology-footer-stats {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 5;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--leather);
      padding-top: 1.5rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--rag);
    }

    /* Section 4: The Thesis Crucible (Full Book Spread) */
    .crucible-section {
      background: var(--oxblood);
      padding: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 6rem) var(--gutter);
      position: relative;
    }

    .crucible-container {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .spread-folio-frame {
      border: 1px solid var(--leather);
      background: #15110F;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      box-shadow: 0 40px 100px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
      position: relative;
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .spread-folio-frame {
        grid-template-columns: 3.5fr 5fr 3.5fr;
      }
    }

    .folio-left-margin {
      padding: 2.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--leather);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--graphite);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .folio-left-margin {
        border-bottom: none;
        border-right: 1px solid var(--leather);
      }
    }

    .source-quote-card {
      border-left: 2px solid var(--vermilion);
      padding-left: 1rem;
      font-style: italic;
      color: var(--rag);
    }

    .source-quote-card cite {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
      font-style: normal;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--vermilion);
    }

    .folio-main-leaf {
      padding: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 4rem);
      background: #171310;
    }

    .leaf-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--leather);
      padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--graphite);
    }

    .thesis-draft-body h1 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .thesis-draft-body p {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      line-height: 1.75;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      text-indent: 1.5rem;
    }

    .thesis-draft-body p.no-indent {
      text-indent: 0;
    }

    .thesis-draft-body .drop-cap::first-letter {
      float: left;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 4.8rem;
      line-height: 0.8;
      padding-top: 4px;
      padding-right: 12px;
      padding-bottom: 0px;
      color: var(--vermilion);
    }

    .folio-right-margin {
      padding: 2.5rem;
      background: #14100E;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--leather);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .folio-right-margin {
        border-top: none;
        border-left: 1px solid var(--leather);
      }
    }

    .advisor-critique {
      background: rgba(224, 90, 43, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid var(--vermilion);
      padding: 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--rag);
    }

    .critique-sender {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.6875rem;
      color: var(--vermilion);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }

    /* Photographic Monograph Gallery Row */
    .photo-interstitial-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-top: 3.5rem;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .photo-interstitial-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 8fr 4fr;
      }
    }

    .photo-frame-featured {
      height: 480px;
      border: 1px solid var(--leather);
      position: relative;
    }

    .photo-frame-caption {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      padding: 1.25rem 1.75rem;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(27,23,20,0.95), transparent);
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-style: italic;
      color: var(--rag);
    }

    .photo-frame-tall {
      height: 480px;
      border: 1px solid var(--leather);
      position: relative;
    }

    /* Section 5: BibTeX Without Tears (Brutalist Ledger Table) */
    .bibtex-section {
      background: #14100E;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--leather);
      padding: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 6rem) var(--gutter);
    }

    .bibtex-container {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .bibtex-header {
      margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
    }

    .bibtex-header h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
      font-weight: 300;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .ledger-table-wrap {
      overflow-x: auto;
      border: 1px solid var(--leather);
      background: var(--oxblood);
    }

    .ledger-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      text-align: left;
      min-width: 720px;
    }

    .ledger-table th {
      background: #1C1715;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--leather);
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      color: var(--rag);
    }

    .ledger-table td {
      padding: 1.25rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(74, 59, 50, 0.5);
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .ledger-table tr:hover td {
      background: rgba(244, 239, 230, 0.02);
    }

    .badge-verified {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: #38b000;
      background: rgba(56, 176, 0, 0.1);
      padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    .badge-broken {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--vermilion);
      background: rgba(224, 90, 43, 0.1);
      padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    .bib-citekey {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      color: var(--vermilion);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Section 6: Testimonials from the Defense */
    .defense-section {
      padding: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 6rem) var(--gutter);
      background: #161210;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--leather);
    }

    .defense-container {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .defense-header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 60ch;
      margin: 0 auto 4rem;
    }

    .defense-header h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
      font-weight: 300;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
    }

    .book-jacket-trio {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .book-jacket-trio {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
    }

    .book-jacket {
      background: #1A1513;
      border: 1px solid var(--leather);
      padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      min-height: 480px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
    }

    .book-jacket::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 14px;
      width: 2px;
      background: rgba(244, 239, 230, 0.08);
      box-shadow: 1px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    }

    .book-jacket:hover {
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      border-color: var(--vermilion);
    }

    .jacket-spine-title {

      <span>PRINTED DIGITALLY ON 100% POST-CONSUMER ELECTRONS</span>

  <!-- Vanilla Interaction: Spine Stack Hover Synchronisation -->
  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const tomeEntries = document.querySelectorAll('.tome-entry');
      const ribbonCallout = document.getElementById('dynamicRibbonCallout');

      const marginaliaSnippets = [
        {
          title: "Anchor Eq. (3): Self-Attention Mechanism",
          body: "Directly bound to Chapter 3: Latent Representations under Dr. Vance's review."
        },
        {
          title: "Theorem 2: Noisy-Channel Coding",
          body: "Cross-linked to 14 proof sheets. Backlink active with Shannon (1948) p. 392."
        },
        {
          title: "Section 7: The Imitation Game Fallacy",
          body: "Connected to philosophical critique draft in § 2.1 epistemology chapter."
        }
      ];

      tomeEntries.forEach((entry, idx) => {
        entry.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
          tomeEntries.forEach(e => e.classList.remove('active'));
          entry.classList.add('active');

          if (marginaliaSnippets[idx] && ribbonCallout) {
            ribbonCallout.innerHTML = `
              <strong>${marginaliaSnippets[idx].title}</strong>
              <p style="margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; opacity: 0.9;">${marginaliaSnippets[idx].body}</p>
            `;
          }
        });
      });
    });
  </script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>KRAFTWERK TIMBER ARCHITEKTUR — Precision Engineered Mass Timber Mid-Rise</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Syne:wght@700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-carbon: #111215;
      --bg-surface: #181A1F;
      --bg-surface-elevated: #21242B;
      --text-primary: #F4F4F0;
      --text-muted: #7A7E85;
      --vermilion: #FF4D15;
      --spruce-accent: #D8B288;
      --border-subtle: rgba(244, 244, 240, 0.12);
      --border-strong: rgba(244, 244, 240, 0.28);
      --font-display: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      --font-text: 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, monospace;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    body {
      background-color: var(--bg-carbon);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-family: var(--font-text);
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      font-feature-settings: "zero" 1, "tnum" 1;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    /* GRID & UTILITY */
    .grid-frame {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
      gap: 0;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    }

    .border-b { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
    .border-t { border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
    .border-r { border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
    .border-l { border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }

    .tabular-num {
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    /* NAVIGATION HEADER */
    header.site-header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 900;
      background-color: var(--bg-carbon);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }

    .nav-inner {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: stretch;
      min-height: 64px;
    }

    .brand-mark {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 0 28px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      background: var(--bg-carbon);
    }

    .vermilion-pill {
      background: var(--vermilion);
      color: #000;
      font-family: var(--font-text);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .header-status {
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 24px;
      padding: 0 32px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    }

    .header-status span strong {
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .header-cta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0 28px;
      background: var(--vermilion);
      color: #000;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 12px;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.2s;
    }

    .header-cta:hover {
      background: #fff;
      color: #000;
    }

    /* HERO SECTION */
    .hero-section {
      position: relative;
      background: var(--bg-carbon);
    }

    .hero-meta-strip {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .meta-cell {
      padding: 14px 24px;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    }
    .meta-cell:last-child {
      border-right: none;
    }
    .meta-cell span.val {
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-left: 8px;
    }

    .hero-headline-wrap {
      padding: 72px 28px 48px 28px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 7.8vw, 7.4rem);
      line-height: 0.92;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      max-width: 16ch;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .hero-title span.slash {
      color: var(--vermilion);
    }

    .hero-body-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 7fr 5fr;
      min-height: 520px;
    }

    .hero-photo-container {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      background: #000;
    }

    .hero-photo-container img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 480px;
      filter: contrast(1.1) brightness(0.9);
      transition: transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .hero-photo-container:hover img {
      transform: scale(1.02);
    }

    /* Reticle signature detail */
    .reticle-callout {
      position: absolute;
      top: 38%;
      left: 54%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 10;
    }

    .reticle-cross {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .reticle-cross::before,
    .reticle-cross::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      background: var(--vermilion);
    }
    .reticle-cross::before {
      top: 50%;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 1px;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
    }
    .reticle-cross::after {
      left: 50%;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 1px;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
    }

    .reticle-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: -24px;
      left: 28px;
      background: var(--bg-carbon);
      border: 1px solid var(--vermilion);
      padding: 3px 8px;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--vermilion);
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      white-space: nowrap;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-family: var(--font-text);
    }

    .hero-telemetry-col {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      padding: 40px 36px;
    }

    .carbon-counter-block {
      border-left: 2px solid var(--vermilion);
      padding-left: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .carbon-counter-block .label {
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .carbon-counter-block .metric {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4.4vw, 3.8rem);
      line-height: 1;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .carbon-counter-block .sub {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--spruce-accent);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .hero-copy-lead {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.55;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .hero-lead-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      padding-top: 24px;
    }

    .stat-item .k {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .stat-item .v {
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    /* SECTION HEADER SYSTEM */
    .section-header-band {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: baseline;
      padding: 24px 28px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      background: var(--bg-carbon);
    }

    .section-eyebrow {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      color: var(--vermilion);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.2vw, 2.6rem);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }

    .section-idx {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* ASSEMBLY SEQUENCE INTERACTIVE (STRIPE PRESS-STYLE STACK) */
    .sequence-section {
      background: var(--bg-carbon);
    }

    .sequence-interactive-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    }

    .sequence-slab {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 80px 140px 1fr 280px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 24px 28px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      background: var(--bg-carbon);
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
      transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .sequence-slab::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 4px;
      background: transparent;
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }

    .sequence-slab:hover {
      background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
      padding-left: 36px;
    }

    .sequence-slab:hover::before,
    .sequence-slab.active::before {
      background: var(--vermilion);
    }

    .seq-step {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--vermilion);
    }

    .seq-day {
      font-size: 12px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      color: var(--spruce-accent);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .seq-title-wrap h3 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .seq-title-wrap p {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      max-width: 64ch;
    }

    .seq-metric-pill {
      text-align: right;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-family: var(--font-text);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .seq-metric-pill span.metric-val {
      display: block;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    /* URBAN TYPOLOGIES TRIPTYCH */
    .typologies-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 7fr 5fr;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      background: var(--bg-carbon);
    }

    .dominant-plate {
      position: relative;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      min-height: 680px;
      background: #080809;
    }

    .dominant-plate .plate-media {
      position: relative;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .dominant-plate img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 680px;
      filter: contrast(1.15) brightness(0.9);
      transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .dominant-plate:hover img {
      transform: scale(1.03);
    }

    .plate-overlay-card {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(17,18,21,0) 0%, rgba(17,18,21,0.95) 40%, rgba(17,18,21,1) 100%);
      padding: 48px 32px 32px 32px;
    }

    .plate-badge-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .badge-vermilion {
      background: var(--vermilion);
      color: #000;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }

    .badge-outline {
      border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }

    .plate-overlay-card h3 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 2.8vw, 2.6rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .plate-overlay-card p.location-meta {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--spruce-accent);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }

    .plate-metrics-strip {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      padding-top: 16px;
    }

    .p-metric span {
      display: block;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    }

    .p-metric strong {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .stacked-cards-col {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .typology-subcard {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 32px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      position: relative;

    .typology-subcard:last-child {

    }

    .subcard-top {
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .subcard-top h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;

    .subcard-top p.desc {

    .subcard-metrics-row {

    .subcard-metrics-row div span {

      text-transform: uppercase;

      letter-spacing: 0.06em;

    .subcard-metrics-row div strong {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-primary);

    /* MASSIVE SIGNATURE COLOR BLOCK: THE DENSITY MANIFESTO */
    .manifesto-block {
      background: var(--vermilion);
      color: #000;
      padding: 96px 28px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #000;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .manifesto-inner {
      max-width: 1180px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border: 2px solid #000;
      padding: 56px 48px;
      position: relative;
    }

    /* Engineering corner notches */
    .manifesto-inner::before {
      content: '+ TECTONIC REF. MK-7 // NORMATIVE SPEC // FIRE RESISTANCE CLASS F90-B';
      position: absolute;
      top: -12px;
      left: 24px;
      background: var(--vermilion);
      padding: 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--font-text);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    }

    .manifesto-inner::after {
      content: 'BERLIN // STOCKHOLM // VIENNA';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -11px;
      right: 24px;
      background: var(--vermilion);
      padding: 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--font-text);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    }

    .manifesto-quote {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.4vw, 3.8rem);
      line-height: 1.05;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      color: #000;
    }

    .manifesto-attribution {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-end;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
      border-top: 2px solid #000;
      padding-top: 24px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* 21:9 VIDEO/CINEMATIC VIEWPORT */
    .film-viewport-section {
      background: #000;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      position: relative;
    }

    .cinematic-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 0;

      content: '+';
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      color: var(--vermilion);
      font-size: 24px;
      line-height: 1;

The Masthead
The Florist’s Gazette

Ephemeral beauty, delivered on schedule.

Vol. IV — The Tulip Harvest

This week, we look toward the lowlands. Our selection focuses on the Parrot Tulip, a variety often misunderstood for its jagged edges, yet prized by the Dutch masters for its painterly disposition.

"A flower does not exist in a vacuum; it is a guest in your home, a silent participant in your morning tea and evening reflections."

We have curated these stems to arrive in tight buds, allowing you to witness the gradual unfurling over seven days. They are best placed where the morning sun can catch the feathered tips of their petals.

Select your chapter

Chapter I

The Minimalist

A focused study of a single variety. Five to seven stems chosen for their structural integrity and longevity.

£28 / week Begin Membership
Chapter II

The Romantic

A narrative arrangement. Seasonal focal flowers supported by wild gestures of foliage and scent.

£45 / week Begin Membership
Chapter III

The Grand

An editorial statement. Large-scale stems designed for entryways or dining tables. Bold, rare, and theatrical.

£85 / week Begin Membership
Notes from the Field

The quiet labor of slow growth.

At our farm in the Sussex Weald, the rhythm of the season dictates our editorial calendar. Unlike the industrial florist, we do not force blooms. We wait for the soil to speak.

Sustainable farming is, at its heart, a form of patience. We use no synthetic pesticides, preferring to let the ecosystem find its own balance. This means our stems may be slightly irregular—a curve in the neck, a freckle on the leaf—but they possess a vitality that hothouse flowers simply cannot replicate.

When you receive your Gazette box, you are receiving the culmination of six months of stewardship. It is a piece of the earth, temporarily relocated to your mantelpiece.
